deployment: Prepare and verify only. Do not overwrite dist, restart the live server/tunnel, or reset shared data.

verification.command: npm run check (SAMFORD_LIVE_PROOF=1 on the original local deployment)

remainingGaps: External providers, hardware, real signing and unavailable native-only security remain explicit simulations.
All 349 illustrated states and every optional branch are not claimed exhaustively verified.
Technical record keys, developer diagnostics, server validation messages and some explanatory copy remain English; no complete human linguistic review or PDF/UA certification.
No scale, regulatory, accessibility certification or production-readiness claim.
Production billing authority, ETHER migration and staff-identity ownership remain the documented demo assumptions.

requirements.scope: Paper prescription intake with entered doctor name, registration number and a readable attached scan; batch and dispensing safeguards apply. Not OCR or automatic prescribing.
Drag ordering, hide/unhide, row count, shortcuts and reset to hospital defaults; referrals/results and department-locked cards cannot be hidden.
Counts and UHIDs only for each open-work group, explicit consultant or department-queue recipient per group, unsent recovery choice, preserved author and blocked removal when incomplete.
Repeat a weekly pattern in the monthly clinical on-call roster, excluding suspended/deactivated doctors; preview conflicts and retain change reason. Not staff duty-roster/HR management.
Emergency can move a planned case with a reason and durable surgeon notification; atomically validate both slots and prohibit moving a case already in theatre.

Master-owned effective payer/package rates, approved amount/expiry and patient share, independent deduction ownership approval, original-mode net refunds, advances, day-end reconciliation and exports for accounts.
Do not build the hospital accounting ledger, payroll, HR, live schemes, real settlement or migration. Export day-end and claim totals only.

A staff identity may have several staff roles and see their combined menus; server scope is the union, original user attribution remains, and changing role cannot bypass independent-person approvals. Do not create admin-as-doctor impersonation.

Hindi labels and printable document language for doctor and patient portal, English/Hindi consent forms, licensed embedded Unicode font. No automatic translation of authored clinical text. Full Hindi admin/operations UI is not required by these PRDs.

Keep external providers and unavailable native-only device features explicitly simulated; do not claim production authentication, clinical signing, OS screenshot prevention, biometric capture or real integrations.

browserEvidencePolicy: Every claimed browser-covered named journey requires user-like interaction plus a resulting state/read assertion. Render and overflow checks remain a separate smoke-test dimension.
